# expect-pr-not-covered-raises

If reconcile is called with an expect_pr and that PR is not found among merged PRs after the watermark, reconcile raises CompileError. This enforces caller expectations but is a hard failure mode the caller must handle.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
